description: Skill Hub quality ladder. Single source of truth for tools/quality.py and the site /skills/scoring page. Points are 0 to 100: the category caps sum to max_points. v1.2 (pre-launch, 2026-10-22, after the independent quality audit): point values are unchanged; what counts as evidence is stricter, see `rules`. Previous tables live in scoring/history/. After launch, values change only at season boundaries with 30 days notice.
rules: Evidence is classified by the SIGNING KEY, never by the label on the artifact: self (recorded by the author), maintainer (signed with the author's or a maintainer-tier key, whatever verifier name it carries), ci (a platform verifier with its own key; none exists yet), independent (a SIGNERS key that is neither the author's nor maintainer-tier).
Only independent evidence earns independent points. Maintainer-signed replays and CI reproductions are shown on the card and feed maintenance, never the independent category.

A run counts only for the code on disk: its recorded version must equal the current version and, when it carries skill_sha256, that digest must equal the current shipped-file digest. Runs on older versions are shown as previous versions and earn nothing.

Run credit is per action: self, maintainer, ci and independent run counts are the minimum over the skill's actions of passing current runs that exercised that action. A skill with eight actions and runs for one has zero.
Validators earn points only on actions that have at least one passing current run, and never for a skill in status draft; the weakest action decides.
An independent device class counts only for a fingerprint the author has not recorded on; one report per fingerprint.

Maintenance (re-verified) comes from maintainer, ci or independent passing runs of the current version, never from the author's own runs; full value within 30 days, then a linear decay to zero at 60 days measured against the real build date.
Bench models are counted from verified artifacts that carry a bench block with an agent model; declarations in bench.yaml earn nothing. The deterministic replay arm is not a model.
A manifest is valid only when the loader reports no missing required field; official skills get no exception.
Emulator runs are recorded as such (emulator: true); artifacts without the field are reported as unknown, never as hardware.
Simulated (fake-device) runs, unsigned, tampered, mis-attributed artifacts and artifacts whose verifier field is missing are rejected and listed under rejected.

Trust is separate from quality: official (ghost), benchmark (imported AndroidWorld scaffolds), verified (a maintainer recorded a code review in skillhub/REVIEWED), unverified (everyone else). Verified is never automatic.
Downloads and likes are displayed and worth 0 points. Point values change only at season boundaries with 30 days notice.
Not enforced yet (planned): reciprocal verification caps, 14-day account age, random re-execution, tier freeze on a failing newer app version.
